text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to suit the winch base (check against the winch bought).

svg.text: It is welded flat on the outer face of leg 1 (the face away

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the well), its 300 mm length along the leg, its middle
